re_run_provenance.deciding_record: the last END record for the label in rows.log
re_run_provenance.note: A row counted as a pass may have failed an earlier attempt. Where the deciding record carries the serial discriminator's marker, the row was re-run on the same commit, node id and interpreter inside a measured low-load window after the parallel attempt lost the host-contention race. No bound, timeout, tolerance, skip or xfail differs between the two attempts; only the ambient load does, and the load actually observed is recorded in serial_rounds.
